comment: §21.6's screen (ABUSE-M5-01; QD-807): a case with no screen, or screen name, is ScreenName(name, facts), for a label draw, an alias or a Team scope label; screen host is ScreenHost(name, facts), for a host inside a network's own zone, a record owner's label or a published host. Each answers verdict, one of deny, review and allow. facts null is, to ScreenName, a label draw and, to ScreenHost, a network of which nothing is known. In facts, verified_brands names brands whose domains, as ScreenBrands lists them, the network verified (* for every brand), so no real domain is written here; verified_domains are written out; probation, review_allowed and scope_labels are ScreenFacts' fields.
